question: In what year did Fusajiro Yamauchi start the business that became Nintendo by making hanafuda playing cards in Kyoto?
answer: Fusajiro Yamauchi started the business in 1889, making hanafuda playing cards in Kyoto. [2][4] Nintendo's own history pages give 1889 as the founding year [1][2][4], and Wikipedia (as of November 2026) says it was founded as Nintendo Koppai on 23 September 1889 [5]. Another Wikipedia page likewise dates the start to 1889 [6].
